translations.literal: Tigan was upright, forceful, and principled; he argued in every memorial, accumulated offense to the emperor's intent, and in the end was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Tigan was upright, forceful, and principled; he argued in every memorial, accumulated offense to the emperor, and in the end was stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 給事中光懋、御史淩琯等交章請留，不聽。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Guang Mao, Censor Ling Guan, and others submitted joint memorials asking that he be kept; the emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Guang Mao, Censor Ling Guan, and others submitted joint memorials asking that he be retained; the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 神宗即位，起南京兵部尚書，奏言：「留都根本重地，故額軍九萬，馬五千餘匹。

translations.literal: When Shenzong took the throne, he was recalled to serve as Minister of War at Nanjing and memorialized: "The southern capital is a fundamental base; the established quota is ninety thousand troops and more than five thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenzong took the throne, he was recalled to serve as Minister of War at Nanjing and memorialized, "The southern capital is a fundamental base; the established quota is ninety thousand troops and more than five thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 今軍止二萬二千，馬僅及半，單弱足慮。

translations.literal: Today the troops number only twenty-two thousand, and horses barely reach half that—this weakness is sufficient cause for concern.
translations.idiomatic: Today the troops number only twenty-two thousand, and horses barely reach half that—this weakness is sufficient cause for concern.

sentences.zh: 宜選諸衛余丁，隨伍操練，發貯庫草場銀買馬。」

translations.literal: It is fitting to select surplus men from the various guards, drill them with their companies, and use silver from the storage treasuries and meadow funds to buy horses."
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to select surplus men from the various guards, drill them with their companies, and use silver from the storage treasuries and meadow funds to buy horses."

sentences.zh: 又條上防守四事。

translations.literal: He also itemized four matters for defense.
translations.idiomatic: He also itemized four matters for defense.

sentences.zh: 並從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二年致仕，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wanli he retired; he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Wanli he retired; he died.

sentences.zh: 贈太子少保。

translations.literal: He was posthumously given the title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 王廷，字子正，南充人。

translations.literal: Wang Ting, styled Zizheng, was a man of Nanchong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ting, styled Zizheng, was a native of Nanchong.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十一年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the eleventh year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examinations in the eleventh year of Jiajing (1532).

sentences.zh: 授戶部主事，改御史。

translations.literal: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred to be a censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue and transferred to serve as a censor.

sentences.zh: 疏劾吏部尚書汪鋐，謫亳州判官。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching Minister of Personnel Wang Hong and was demoted to assistant magistrate of Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized impeaching Minister of Personnel Wang Hong and was demoted to assistant magistrate of Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 歷蘇州知府，有政聲。

translations.literal: He served as prefect of Suzhou and had a reputation for good governance.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Suzhou and earned a reputation for good governance.

sentences.zh: 累遷右副都御史，總理河道。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and supervised the waterways.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and supervised the waterways.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，轉南京戶部右侍郎，總督糧儲。

translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of Revenue in Nanjing and Grand Coordinator of grain storage.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year (1560) he was transferred to Right Vice Minister of Revenue in Nanjing and appointed Grand Coordinator of grain storage.

sentences.zh: 南京督儲，自成化後皆以都御史領之，至嘉靖二十六年，始命戶部侍郎兼理。

translations.literal: Supervision of storage in Nanjing after Chenghua had always been led by a censor-in-chief; only in the twenty-sixth year of Jiajing was a vice minister of revenue ordered to handle it concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: Supervision of storage in Nanjing after Chenghua had always been led by a censor-in-chief; only in the twenty-sixth year of Jiajing was a vice minister of revenue ordered to handle it concurrently.

sentences.zh: 及振武營軍亂，言者請復舊制，遂以副都御史章煥專領，而改廷南京刑部。

translations.literal: When the Zhenwu Camp troops mutinied, critics asked to restore the old system; Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Huan was then put solely in charge, and Ting was transferred to the Ministry of Justice in Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhenwu Camp troops mutinied, critics asked to restore the old system; Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Huan was then put solely in charge, and Ting was transferred to the Ministry of Justice in Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 未上，復改戶部右侍郎兼左僉都御史，總督漕運，巡撫鳳陽諸府。

translations.literal: Before he took up the post, he was again changed to Right Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrently Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, Grand Coordinator of the grain transport and Grand Coordinator of Fengyang and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Before he took up the post, he was reassigned as Right Vice Minister of Revenue and concurrently Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, Grand Coordinator of the grain transport and Grand Coordinator of Fengyang and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 時倭亂未靖，廷建議以江南屬鎮守總兵官，專駐吳淞，江北屬分守副總兵，專駐狼山。

translations.literal: As the pirate turmoil was not yet settled, Ting proposed that south of the Yangzi belong to the regional commander and be stationed solely at Wusong, and north of the river belong to the deputy regional commander on defense duty and be stationed solely at Langshan.
translations.idiomatic: As the pirate turmoil was not yet settled, Ting proposed that south of the Yangzi fall under the regional commander stationed solely at Wusong, and north of the river fall under the deputy regional commander on defense duty stationed solely at Langshan.

sentences.zh: 遂為定制。

translations.literal: This then became the fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: This then became the fixed regulation.

sentences.zh: 淮安大饑，與巡按御史朱綱奏留商稅餉軍，被詔切讓。

translations.literal: Huai'an suffered great famine; together with touring censor Zhu Gang he memorialized to retain merchant tax to feed the army and was sharply rebuked by edict.
translations.idiomatic: When Huai'an suffered great famine, he and touring censor Zhu Gang memorialized to retain merchant tax to feed the army and were sharply rebuked by edict.

sentences.zh: 給事中李邦義因劾廷拘滯，吏部尚書嚴訥為廷辨，始解。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Li Bangyi thereupon impeached Ting for being inflexible; Minister of Personnel Yan Ne argued on Ting's behalf, and the matter was finally cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Li Bangyi thereupon impeached Ting for being inflexible; Minister of Personnel Yan Ne argued on Ting's behalf, and the matter was finally cleared.

sentences.zh: 轉左侍郎，還理部事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the left vice ministership and returned to handle ministry affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the left vice ministership and returned to handle ministry affairs.

sentences.zh: 以通州禦倭功，加俸二級。

translations.literal: For merit in defending against pirates at Tongzhou, his salary rank was raised two grades.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in defending against pirates at Tongzhou, his salary rank was raised two grades.

sentences.zh: 遷南京禮部尚書，召為左都御史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be Minister of Rites in Nanjing and summoned to be Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as Minister of Rites in Nanjing and summoned to serve as Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 奏行慎選授、重分巡、謹刑獄、端表率、嚴檢束、公舉劾六事。

translations.literal: He memorialized to implement six measures: careful selection and appointment, weight on circuit inspection, caution in criminal cases, rectitude in personal example, strict discipline, and fairness in impeachment and recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized to implement six measures: careful selection and appointment, greater weight on circuit inspection, caution in criminal cases, rectitude in personal example, strict discipline, and fairness in impeachment and recommendation.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年六月，京師雨潦壞廬舍，命廷督御史分行振恤。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Longqing, rain and floods in the capital destroyed houses; Ting was ordered to supervise censors in dividing routes for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Longqing (1567), rain and floods in the capital destroyed houses; Ting was ordered to supervise censors in dividing routes for relief.

sentences.zh: 會朝覲天下官，廷請嚴禁饋遺，酌道里費，以儆官邪，蘇民力。

translations.literal: When officials from throughout the empire came for the audience, Ting asked that gifts be strictly forbidden and travel expenses regulated, to warn against official corruption and ease the people's burden.
translations.idiomatic: When officials from throughout the empire came for the audience, Ting asked that gifts be strictly forbidden and travel expenses regulated, to warn against official corruption and ease the people's burden.

sentences.zh: 帝謁諸陵，詔廷同英國公張溶居守。

translations.literal: When the emperor visited the tombs, he ordered Ting together with the Duke of Ying, Zhang Rong, to remain and guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited the tombs, he ordered Ting together with the Duke of Ying, Zhang Rong, to remain and guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 中官許義挾刃脅人財，為巡城御史李學道所笞。

translations.literal: The eunuch Xu Yi used a blade to extort people's property and was beaten by city-patrol censor Li Xuedao.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Xu Yi used a blade to extort people's property and was beaten by city-patrol censor Li Xuedao.

sentences.zh: 群珰伺學道早朝，邀擊之左掖門外。

translations.literal: A crowd of eunuchs waited for Xuedao at the early audience and ambushed him outside the Left Flank Gate.
translations.idiomatic: A crowd of eunuchs waited for Xuedao at the early audience and ambushed him outside the Left Flank Gate.

sentences.zh: 廷上其狀，論戍有差。

translations.literal: Ting reported the facts, and banishment was imposed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Ting reported the facts, and banishment was imposed in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 御史齊康為高拱劾徐階，廷言：「康懷奸黨邪，不重懲無以定國是。」

translations.literal: Censor Qi Kang, acting for Gao Gong, impeached Xu Jie; Ting said: "Kang harbors treacherous factional intent; without heavy punishment the nation's right course cannot be settled."
translations.idiomatic: Censor Qi Kang, acting for Gao Gong, impeached Xu Jie; Ting said, "Kang harbors treacherous factional intent; without heavy punishment the nation's right course cannot be settled."

sentences.zh: 帝為謫康，諭留階。

translations.literal: The emperor demoted Kang on his account and ordered that Jie be kept.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor demoted Kang on his account and ordered that Jie be retained.

sentences.zh: 拱遂引疾去。

translations.literal: Gao then cited illness and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Gao then cited illness and withdrew from office.

sentences.zh: 而給事中張齊者，嘗行邊，受賈人金。

translations.literal: But Supervising Secretary Zhang Qi had once toured the frontier and accepted gold from a merchant.
translations.idiomatic: But Supervising Secretary Zhang Qi had once toured the frontier and accepted gold from a merchant.

sentences.zh: 事稍泄，陰求階子璠居間，璠謝不見。

translations.literal: When the matter leaked slightly, he secretly sought Xu Jie's son Fan as intermediary; Fan declined and would not see him.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter leaked slightly, he secretly sought Xu Jie's son Fan as intermediary; Fan declined and would not see him.

sentences.zh: 齊恨，遂摭康疏語復論階，階亦引疾去。

translations.literal: Qi hated this and then picked phrases from Kang's memorial to attack Jie again; Jie also cited illness and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Qi hated this and picked phrases from Kang's memorial to attack Jie again; Jie also cited illness and withdrew from office.

sentences.zh: 廷因發齊奸利事，言：「齊前奉命賞軍宣大，納鹽商楊四和數千金，為言恤邊商、革余鹽數事，為大學士階所格。

translations.literal: Ting then exposed Qi's corrupt dealings, saying: "Qi earlier received orders to reward troops in Xuan and Da, accepted several thousand in gold from salt merchant Yang Sihe, and spoke for relief to frontier merchants and abolition of surplus salt and other matters—all blocked by Grand Secretary Jie.
translations.idiomatic: Ting then exposed Qi's corrupt dealings, saying, "Qi earlier received orders to reward troops in Xuanfu and Datong, accepted several thousand taels of gold from salt merchant Yang Sihe, and spoke for relief to frontier merchants and abolition of surplus salt and other matters—all blocked by Grand Secretary Jie.

sentences.zh: 四和抵齊取賄，蹤跡頗露。

translations.literal: Sihe went to Qi to recover the bribe, and the trail was rather exposed.
translations.idiomatic: Sihe went to Qi to recover the bribe, and the trail was rather exposed.

sentences.zh: 齊懼得罪，乃借攻階冀自掩。」

translations.literal: Qi feared punishment and therefore borrowed an attack on Jie hoping to cover himself."
translations.idiomatic: Qi feared punishment and therefore attacked Jie in the hope of covering himself."

sentences.zh: 遂下齊詔獄。

translations.literal: Qi was then sent to the imperial prison by edict.
translations.idiomatic: Qi was then sent to the imperial prison by edict.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書毛愷當齊戍，詔釋為民。

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Mao Kai sentenced Qi to banishment, but an edict released him as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Justice Mao Kai sentenced Qi to banishment, but an edict released him as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 拱起再相，廷恐其修郤，而愷亦階所引，遂先後乞休以避之。

translations.literal: When Gao was raised and became chief minister again, Ting feared he would nurse a grudge, and Kai too had been introduced by Jie; they therefore asked to retire one after another to avoid him.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao was raised and became chief minister again, Ting feared he would nurse a grudge, and Kai too had been introduced by Jie; they therefore asked to retire one after another to avoid him.

sentences.zh: 給事中周蕓、御史李純樸訟齊事，謂廷、愷阿階意，羅織不辜。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zhou Yun and Censor Li Chunpu pleaded Qi's case, saying Ting and Kai favored Jie's intent and fabricated charges against the innocent.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Zhou Yun and Censor Li Chunpu pleaded Qi's case, saying Ting and Kai favored Jie's intent and fabricated charges against the innocent.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書劉自強覆奏：「齊所坐無實，廷、愷屈法徇私。」

translations.literal: Minister of Justice Liu Ziqiang memorialized in reply: "Qi's offenses have no substance; Ting and Kai bent the law for private ends."
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Justice Liu Ziqiang memorialized in reply, "Qi's offenses have no substance; Ting and Kai bent the law for private ends."

sentences.zh: 詔奪愷職，廷斥為民，宥齊，補通州判官。

translations.literal: An edict stripped Kai of office, dismissed Ting as a commoner, pardoned Qi, and appointed him assistant magistrate of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stripped Kai of office, dismissed Ting as a commoner, pardoned Qi, and appointed him assistant magistrate of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 萬歷初，齊以不謹罷，愷已前卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wanli, Qi was dismissed for impropriety; Kai had already died earlier.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Wanli reign, Qi was dismissed for impropriety; Kai had already died earlier.

sentences.zh: 浙江巡按御史謝廷傑訟愷狷潔有古人風，坐按張齊奪官，今齊已黜，足知愷守正。

translations.literal: Zhejiang touring censor Xie Tingjie pleaded that Kai was upright and pure with the air of the ancients; he lost office for handling Zhang Qi's case, and now that Qi has been removed, it is enough to show Kai upheld righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang touring censor Xie Tingjie pleaded that Kai was upright and pure with the air of the ancients; he lost office for handling Zhang Qi's case, and now that Qi has been removed, it is enough to show Kai upheld righteousness.

sentences.zh: 詔復愷官。

translations.literal: An edict restored Kai's office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored Kai's office posthumously.

sentences.zh: 於是巡撫四川都御史曾省吾言：「廷守蘇州時，人比之趙清獻。

translations.literal: Then Grand Coordinator of Sichuan Zeng Shengyu said: "When Ting governed Suzhou, people compared him to Zhao Qingxian.
translations.idiomatic: Then Grand Coordinator of Sichuan Zeng Shengyu said, "When Ting governed Suzhou, people compared him to Zhao Qingxian.

sentences.zh: 直節勁氣，始終無改。

translations.literal: His upright integrity and firm spirit never changed from start to finish.
translations.idiomatic: His upright integrity and firm spirit never changed from start to finish.

sentences.zh: 宜如毛愷例復官。」

translations.literal: He should, like Mao Kai, have his office restored."
translations.idiomatic: He should, like Mao Kai, have his office restored."

sentences.zh: 詔以故官致仕。

translations.literal: An edict ordered retirement with his former rank.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him to retire with his former rank.

sentences.zh: 十六年，給夫廩如制，仍以高年特賜存問。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was given bearers and grain allowance as regulations provide, and because of his great age was specially granted imperial inquiry after his welfare.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was given bearers and grain allowance as regulations provide, and because of his great age was specially granted an imperial inquiry after his welfare.

sentences.zh: 明年卒，謚恭節。

translations.literal: The next year he died and was given the posthumous name Gongjie.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he died and was given the posthumous name Gongjie.

sentences.zh: 毛愷，字達和，江山人。

translations.literal: Mao Kai, styled Dahe, was a man of Jiangshan.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Kai, styled Dahe, was a native of Jiangshan.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十四年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the fourteenth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examinations in the fourteenth year of Jiajing (1535).

sentences.zh: 授行人，擢御史。

translations.literal: He was appointed a courier and promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a courier and promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 坐論洗馬鄒守益不當投散地，為執政所惡，謫寧國推官。

translations.literal: Because he argued that Grand Mentor Zou Shouyi should not be sent to a remote post, he was hated by those in power and demoted to investigating officer of Ningguo.
translations.idiomatic: Because he argued that Grand Mentor Zou Shouyi should not be sent to a remote post, he was hated by those in power and demoted to investigating officer of Ningguo.

sentences.zh: 歷刑部尚書。

translations.literal: He rose to be Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to serve as Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 太監李芳驟諫忤穆宗，命刑部置重辟。

translations.literal: The eunuch Li Fang suddenly remonstrated and offended the Muzong emperor; the Ministry of Justice was ordered to impose the death penalty.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Li Fang suddenly remonstrated and offended the Muzong emperor; the Ministry of Justice was ordered to impose the death penalty.

sentences.zh: 愷奏：「芳罪狀未明，非所以示天下公。」

translations.literal: Kai memorialized: "Fang's crimes are not yet clear; this is not how to show fairness to the empire."
translations.idiomatic: Kai memorialized, "Fang's crimes are not yet clear; this is not how to show fairness to the empire."

sentences.zh: 芳仍得貰死。

translations.literal: Fang still obtained commutation to exile.
translations.idiomatic: Fang still obtained commutation to exile.

sentences.zh: 愷贈太子少保，謚端簡。

translations.literal: Kai was posthumously given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Duanjian.
translations.idiomatic: Kai was posthumously honored as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Duanjian.

sentences.zh: 葛守禮，字與立，德平人。

translations.literal: Ge Shouli, styled Yuli, was a man of Dezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ge Shouli, styled Yuli, was a native of Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年，舉鄉試第一。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Jiajing he placed first in the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Jiajing (1528) he placed first in the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 明年成進士，授彰德推官。

translations.literal: The next year he became a jinshi and was appointed investigating officer of Zhangde.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he passed the jinshi examinations and was appointed investigating officer of Zhangde.

sentences.zh: 巨盜誣富家，株連以百數，守禮盡出之。

translations.literal: A great bandit falsely accused a wealthy family, and more than a hundred were implicated; Shouli released them all.
translations.idiomatic: A great bandit falsely accused a wealthy family, and more than a hundred people were implicated; Shouli released them all.

sentences.zh: 主獄者譖之御史。

translations.literal: The officer in charge of the case slandered him to the censor.
translations.idiomatic: The officer in charge of the case slandered him to the censor.

sentences.zh: 會藩府獄久不決，屬守禮，一訊即得，乃大驚服。

translations.literal: It happened that a princely establishment case long unresolved was assigned to Shouli; one interrogation produced the truth, and all were greatly astonished and convinced.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that a princely establishment case long unresolved was assigned to Shouli; one interrogation produced the truth, and all were greatly astonished and convinced.

sentences.zh: 冬至，趙王戒百官朝服賀，守禮獨不可。

translations.literal: At the winter solstice the Prince of Zhao admonished officials to wear court dress in congratulation; Shouli alone would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: At the winter solstice the Prince of Zhao admonished officials to wear court dress in congratulation; Shouli alone would not agree.

sentences.zh: 遷兵部主事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be a secretary in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as a secretary in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 父喪服闋，補禮部。

translations.literal: When mourning for his father ended, he was assigned to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning for his father ended, he was assigned to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 寧府宗人悉錮高墻，後稍得脫，因請封。

translations.literal: Clansmen of the Ning princely establishment had all been imprisoned in high walls; later they gradually escaped and therefore asked for enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: Clansmen of the Ning princely establishment had all been imprisoned in high walls; later they gradually escaped and therefore asked for enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書夏言議量復中尉數人。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Xia Yan deliberated restoring several assistant commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Xia Yan deliberated restoring several assistant commandants.

sentences.zh: 未上，而言入閣，嚴嵩代之。

translations.literal: Before it was submitted, Yan entered the Grand Secretariat and Yan Song replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Before it was submitted, Yan entered the Grand Secretariat and Yan Song replaced him.

sentences.zh: 守禮適遷儀制郎中，駁不行。

translations.literal: Shouli had just been transferred to be a director in the Bureau of Ceremonial Regulations and rejected it; it was not implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli had just been transferred to serve as a director in the Bureau of Ceremonial Regulations and rejected it; the proposal was not implemented.

sentences.zh: 故事，郡王絕，近支得以本爵理府事，不得繼封。

translations.literal: By precedent, when a commandery prince's line died out, a collateral branch might administer the establishment with its own rank but could not succeed to the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, when a commandery prince's line died out, a collateral branch might administer the establishment with its own rank but could not succeed to the enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 交城、懷仁、襄垣近支絕，以繼封請，守禮持之堅。

translations.literal: Collateral lines at Jiaocheng, Huairen, and Xiangyuan had died out and asked for succession enfeoffment; Shouli held firm against it.
translations.idiomatic: Collateral lines at Jiaocheng, Huairen, and Xiangyuan had died out and asked for succession enfeoffment; Shouli held firm against it.

sentences.zh: 會以疾在告，三邸人乘間行賂，遂得請。

translations.literal: When he happened to be on leave for illness, people of the three establishments seized the chance to offer bribes and obtained approval.
translations.idiomatic: When he happened to be on leave for illness, people of the three establishments seized the chance to offer bribes and obtained approval.

sentences.zh: 旗校诇其事以聞。

translations.literal: Banner guards investigated the matter and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Banner guards investigated the matter and reported it.

sentences.zh: 所籍記賂遺十余萬，獨無守禮名，帝由是知守禮廉。

translations.literal: Recorded bribes amounted to more than 100,000, but Shouli's name alone was absent; the emperor thereby knew Shouli was incorrupt.
translations.idiomatic: Recorded bribes amounted to more than a hundred thousand, but Shouli's name alone was absent; the emperor thereby knew Shouli was incorrupt.

sentences.zh: 遷河南提學副使，再遷山西按察使，進陜西布政使，擢右副都御史，巡撫河南。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be Vice Commissioner of Education in Henan, then again to Surveillance Commissioner of Shanxi, advanced to Administrative Commissioner of Shaanxi, and promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as Vice Commissioner of Education in Henan, then to Surveillance Commissioner of Shanxi, advanced to Administrative Commissioner of Shaanxi, and promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Henan.

sentences.zh: 入為戶部侍郎，督餉宣、大。

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Vice Minister of Revenue and supervised supplies in Xuan and Da.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as Vice Minister of Revenue and supervised supplies in Xuanfu and Datong.

sentences.zh: 改吏部。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 自左侍郎遷南京禮部尚書。

translations.literal: From Left Vice Minister he was transferred to Minister of Rites in Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: From Left Vice Minister he was transferred to Minister of Rites in Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 李本署吏部事，希嚴嵩指考察廷臣，署守禮下考，勒致仕。

translations.literal: Li Ben was acting at the Ministry of Personnel; following Yan Song's intent in evaluating court officials, he marked Shouli for low rating and forced him to retire.
translations.idiomatic: Li Ben was acting at the Ministry of Personnel; following Yan Song's intent in evaluating court officials, he marked Shouli for low rating and forced him to retire.

sentences.zh: 後帝問守禮安在，左右謬以老病對。

translations.literal: Later the emperor asked where Shouli was; those around him falsely answered that he was old and ill.
translations.idiomatic: Later the emperor asked where Shouli was; those around him falsely answered that he was old and ill.

sentences.zh: 帝為嘆惜久之。

translations.literal: The emperor sighed in regret for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sighed in regret for a long time.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，起戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing he was raised to Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longqing (1567) he was recalled as Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「畿輔、山東流移日眾，以有司變法亂常，起科太重，征派不均。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "In the metropolitan region and Shandong displaced persons grow daily in number because local officials change laws and disturb norms, initial assessments are too heavy, and levies are unequal.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "In the metropolitan region and Shandong displaced persons grow daily in number because local officials change laws and disturb norms, initial assessments are too heavy, and levies are unequal.

sentences.zh: 且河南北，山東西，土地磽瘠，正供尚不能給，復重之徭役。

translations.literal: Moreover north and south of the Yellow River and east and west of the mountains, the land is barren; regular tribute cannot even be supplied, yet corvée is again increased.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover north and south of the Yellow River and east and west of the mountains, the land is barren; regular tribute cannot even be supplied, yet corvée is again increased.

sentences.zh: 工匠及富商大賈，皆以無田免役，而農夫獨受其困，此所謂舛也。

translations.literal: Artisans and great merchants all escape service because they have no fields, while farmers alone suffer the hardship—this is what is called perversity.
translations.idiomatic: Artisans and great merchants all escape service because they have no fields, while farmers alone suffer the hardship—this is what is called perversity.

sentences.zh: 乞正田賦之規，罷科差之法。

translations.literal: I ask that land-tax regulations be rectified and the method of categorized levies be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that land-tax regulations be rectified and the method of categorized levies be abolished.

sentences.zh: 又國初征糧，戶部定倉庫名目及石數價值，通行所司，分派小民，隨倉上納，完欠之數瞭然可稽。

translations.literal: Again, in the founding of the state grain was levied: the Ministry of Revenue fixed depot names and picul counts and values, circulated them to offices, assigned common people, and had them deliver according to depot—completed and outstanding amounts were clear and auditable.
translations.idiomatic: Again, in the founding of the state grain was levied: the Ministry of Revenue fixed depot names and picul counts and values, circulated them to offices, assigned common people, and had them deliver according to depot—completed and outstanding amounts were clear and auditable.

sentences.zh: 近乃定為一條鞭法，計畝征銀。

translations.literal: Recently it was fixed as the single-whip method, assessing silver by mu.
translations.idiomatic: Recently it was fixed as the single-whip method, assessing silver by mu.

sentences.zh: 不論倉口，不問石數。

translations.literal: Depot outlets were not distinguished and picul counts were not asked.
translations.idiomatic: Depot outlets were not distinguished and picul counts were not asked.

sentences.zh: 吏書夤緣為奸，增減灑派，弊端百出。

translations.literal: Clerks used connections to commit fraud, increasing, decreasing, and scattering assignments; abuses appeared in hundreds.
translations.idiomatic: Clerks used connections to commit fraud, increasing, decreasing, and scattering assignments; abuses appeared in hundreds.

sentences.zh: 至於收解，乃又變為一串鈴法，謂之夥收分解。

translations.literal: As for collection and delivery, it again changed into the linked-bells method, called collective receipt and divided delivery.
translations.idiomatic: As for collection and delivery, it again changed into the linked-bells method, called collective receipt and divided delivery.

sentences.zh: 收者不解，解者不收，收者獲積余之貲，解者任賠補之累。

translations.literal: Those who collected did not deliver; those who delivered did not collect; collectors gained surplus funds, deliverers bore the burden of compensation.
translations.idiomatic: Those who collected did not deliver; those who delivered did not collect; collectors gained surplus funds, deliverers bore the burden of compensation.

sentences.zh: 夫錢谷必分數明而後稽核審，今混而為一，是為那移者地也。

translations.literal: Funds and grain must have clear fractions before audit is thorough; to mix them into one is to give room for diversion.
translations.idiomatic: Funds and grain must have clear fractions before audit is thorough; to mix them into one is to give room for diversion.

sentences.zh: 願敕所司，酌復舊規。」

translations.literal: I wish the responsible offices be ordered to consider restoring the old regulations."
translations.idiomatic: I wish the responsible offices be ordered to consider restoring the old regulations."

sentences.zh: 詔悉舉行。

translations.literal: An edict ordered all implemented.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered all implemented.

sentences.zh: 於是奏定國計簿式，頒行天下。

translations.literal: He then memorialized to fix the form of the state accounts book and promulgated it throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: He then memorialized to fix the form of the state accounts book and promulgated it throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 自嘉靖三十六年以後，完欠、起解、追征之數及貧民不能輸納，備錄簿中。

translations.literal: From the thirty-sixth year of Jiajing onward, figures for completion and arrears, initial delivery, pursuit of collection, and poor people unable to pay were all recorded in the book.
translations.idiomatic: From the thirty-sixth year of Jiajing onward, figures for completion and arrears, initial delivery, pursuit of collection, and poor people unable to pay were all recorded in the book.

sentences.zh: 自府州縣達布政，送戶部稽考，以清隱漏那移侵欺之弊。

translations.literal: From prefectures, departments, and counties up to the provincial administration commission, they were sent to the Ministry of Revenue for audit to clear abuses of concealment, leakage, diversion, and embezzlement.
translations.idiomatic: From prefectures, departments, and counties up to the provincial administration commission, they were sent to the Ministry of Revenue for audit to clear abuses of concealment, leakage, diversion, and embezzlement.

sentences.zh: 又以戶部專理財賦，必周知天下倉庫盈虛，然後可節縮調劑。

translations.literal: He also held that since the Ministry of Revenue specially manages finances and taxes, it must thoroughly know surplus and shortage in depots throughout the empire before it can economize and adjust.
translations.idiomatic: He also held that since the Ministry of Revenue specially manages finances and taxes, it must thoroughly know surplus and shortage in depots throughout the empire before it can economize and adjust.

sentences.zh: 祖宗時令天下歲以文冊報部，乃請遣御史譚啟、馬明謨、張問明、趙巖分行天下董其事，並承敕以行。

translations.literal: In ancestral times the empire yearly reported to the ministry in written registers; he then asked that censors Tan Qi, Ma Mingmo, Zhang Wenming, and Zhao Yan be sent throughout the empire to supervise the matter, bearing imperial orders as they went.
translations.idiomatic: In ancestral times the empire yearly reported to the ministry in written registers; he then asked that censors Tan Qi, Ma Mingmo, Zhang Wenming, and Zhao Yan be sent throughout the empire to supervise the matter, bearing imperial orders as they went.

sentences.zh: 覃恩例嘗邊軍，或言士伍虛冒，宜乘給賞汰之。

translations.literal: By grace ordinances border troops were sometimes rewarded; some said ranks were falsely claimed and that rewards should be used to weed them out.
translations.idiomatic: By grace ordinances border troops were sometimes rewarded; some said ranks were falsely claimed and that rewards should be used to weed them out.

sentences.zh: 守禮言：「此朝廷曠典，乃以賈怨耶？」

translations.literal: Shouli said: "This is a great grace of the court—are we to purchase resentment?"
translations.idiomatic: Shouli said, "This is a great grace of the court—are we to purchase resentment?"

sentences.zh: 議乃止。

translations.literal: The proposal was then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was then stopped.

sentences.zh: 大學士高拱與徐階不相能，舉朝攻拱。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Gao Gong and Xu Jie were incompatible, and the whole court attacked Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Gao Gong and Xu Jie were incompatible, and the whole court attacked Gao.

sentences.zh: 侍郎徐養正、劉自強，拱所厚，亦詣守禮言。

translations.literal: Vice Ministers Xu Yangzheng and Liu Ziqiang, whom Gao favored, also went to speak with Shouli.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Ministers Xu Yangzheng and Liu Ziqiang, whom Gao favored, also went to speak with Shouli.

sentences.zh: 守禮不可，養正等遂論拱。

translations.literal: Shouli would not agree; Yangzheng and the others then attacked Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli would not agree; Yangzheng and the others then attacked Gao.

sentences.zh: 守禮尋乞養母歸。

translations.literal: Shouli soon asked to return home to care for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli soon asked to return home to care for his mother.

sentences.zh: 及拱再相，深德守禮，起為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: When Gao became chief minister again, he deeply appreciated Shouli and raised him to Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao became chief minister again, he deeply appreciated Shouli and raised him to Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 初，階定方士王金等獄，坐妄進藥物，比子殺父律論死。

translations.literal: Earlier Jie had fixed the case of the alchemist Wang Jin and others, sentencing them for rashly presenting drugs by analogy to the statute on a son killing his father.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Jie had fixed the case of the alchemist Wang Jin and others, sentencing them for rashly presenting drugs by analogy to the statute on a son killing his father.

sentences.zh: 詔下法司會訊。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the judiciary to conduct a joint inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the judiciary to conduct a joint inquiry.

sentences.zh: 守禮等議金妄進藥無事實，但習故陶仲文術，左道惑眾，應坐為從律編戍。

translations.literal: Shouli and others deliberated that Jin's rash presentation of drugs had no factual basis, but that he practiced the arts of the late Tao Zhongwen, misled the masses by heterodox ways, and should be sentenced as an accomplice by statute to military exile.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli and others deliberated that Jin's rash presentation of drugs had no factual basis, but that he practiced the arts of the late Tao Zhongwen, misled the masses by heterodox ways, and should be sentenced as an accomplice by statute to military exile.

sentences.zh: 給事中趙奮言：「法司為天下平。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Zhao Fen said: "The judiciary exists to bring fairness to the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Zhao Fen said, "The judiciary exists to bring fairness to the empire.

sentences.zh: 昔則一主於入，而不為先帝地；

translations.literal: Formerly it leaned wholly toward conviction and did not spare the late emperor's position;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly it leaned wholly toward conviction and did not spare the late emperor's position;

sentences.zh: 今則一主於出，而不恤後世議。

translations.literal: now it leans wholly toward acquittal and does not care for later generations' judgment.
translations.idiomatic: now it leans wholly toward acquittal and does not care for later generations' judgment.

sentences.zh: 罪有首而後有從，金等為從，孰為首？

translations.literal: Crimes have principals before there are followers; Jin and the others are followers—who is the principal?
translations.idiomatic: Crimes have principals before there are followers; Jin and the others are followers—who is the principal?

sentences.zh: 將以陶仲文為首，則仲文死已久。

translations.literal: If Tao Zhongwen is taken as principal, Tao has long been dead.
translations.idiomatic: If Tao Zhongwen is taken as principal, Tao has long been dead.

sentences.zh: 為法如此，陛下何賴哉！」

translations.literal: If the law is applied thus, on what can Your Majesty rely!"
translations.idiomatic: If the law is applied thus, on what can Your Majesty rely!"

sentences.zh: 疏入，報聞。

translations.literal: The memorial entered and acknowledgment was returned.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was received and acknowledgment was returned.

sentences.zh: 尋改守禮左都御史。

translations.literal: Soon Shouli was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Shouli was transferred to Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 奏言：「畿內地勢窪下，河道堙塞，遇潦則千里為壑。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "Within the capital region the terrain is low; waterways are blocked, and when floods come a thousand li become ravines.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized, "Within the capital region the terrain is low; waterways are blocked, and when floods come a thousand li become ravines.

sentences.zh: 請仿古井田之制，浚治溝洫，使旱潦有備。」

translations.literal: I ask that following the ancient well-field system, ditches and canals be dredged and repaired so that drought and flood may be provided against."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that following the ancient well-field system, ditches and canals be dredged and repaired so that drought and flood may be provided against."

sentences.zh: 章下有司。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent down to responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 又申明巡撫事宜，條列官箴、士節六事。

translations.literal: He also clarified grand coordinator affairs and listed six matters of official admonition and scholarly integrity.
translations.idiomatic: He also clarified grand coordinator affairs and listed six matters of official admonition and scholarly integrity.

sentences.zh: 守禮議王金獄，與拱合，然不附拱。

translations.literal: Shouli's deliberation in the Wang Jin case agreed with Gao, yet he did not attach himself to Gao.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli's deliberation in the Wang Jin case agreed with Gao, yet he did not attach himself to Gao.

sentences.zh: 後張居正欲以王大臣事構殺拱，守禮力為解，乃免。

translations.literal: Later Zhang Juzheng wished to use the Wang Dachen affair to frame and kill Gao; Shouli worked hard to obtain a resolution, and Gao was spared.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhang Juzheng wished to use the Wang Dachen affair to frame and kill Gao; Shouli worked hard to obtain a resolution, and Gao was spared.

sentences.zh: 階、拱、居正更用事，交相軋。

translations.literal: Jie, Gao, and Juzheng held power in turn, mutually pressing one another.
translations.idiomatic: Jie, Gao, and Juzheng held power in turn, mutually pressing one another.

sentences.zh: 守禮周旋其間，正色獨立，人以為難。

translations.literal: Shouli moved among them with stern integrity and independence; people thought it difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Shouli moved among them with stern integrity and independence; people thought it difficult.

sentences.zh: 萬歷三年，以老乞休。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wanli, on grounds of age he asked to retire.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Wanli (1575), on grounds of age he asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 詔加太子少保，馳驛歸。

translations.literal: An edict added Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; he returned home by post-horses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict added the title of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent; he returned home by post-horses.

sentences.zh: 六年卒。

translations.literal: He died in the sixth year.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth year.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太保，謚端肅。

translations.literal: He was posthumously given Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Duansu.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously honored as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Duansu.

sentences.zh: 靳學顏，字子愚，濟寧人。

translations.literal: Jin Xueyan, styled Ziyu, was a man of Jining.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Xueyan, styled Ziyu, was a native of Jining.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十三年舉鄉試第一。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Jiajing he placed first in the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Jiajing (1534) he placed first in the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 明年成進士，授南陽推官，以廉平稱。

translations.literal: The next year he became a jinshi, was appointed investigating officer of Nanyang, and was known for integrity and fairness.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he passed the jinshi examinations, was appointed investigating officer of Nanyang, and was known for integrity and fairness.

sentences.zh: 歷吉安知府，治行高，累遷左布政使。

translations.literal: He served as prefect of Ji'an; his governance was eminent, and he was promoted in succession to Left Administrative Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as prefect of Ji'an; his governance was eminent, and he was promoted in succession to Left Administrative Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 隆慶初，入為太仆卿，改光祿。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longqing he entered the capital as Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud and was transferred to the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Longqing reign he entered the capital as Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud and was transferred to the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 旋拜右副都御史，巡撫山西。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 應詔陳理財，凡萬余言。

translations.literal: In response to an edict he set forth financial administration in more than ten thousand words.
translations.idiomatic: In response to an edict he set forth financial administration in more than ten thousand words.

sentences.zh: 言選兵、鑄錢、積谷最切。

translations.literal: He said that selecting troops, casting coin, and storing grain were most urgent.
translations.idiomatic: He said that selecting troops, casting coin, and storing grain were most urgent.

sentences.zh: 其略曰：

translations.literal: The summary says:
translations.idiomatic: The summary says:

sentences.zh: 宋初禁軍十萬，總天下諸路亦不過十萬，其後慶歷、治平間增至百余萬。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song the forbidden army was 100,000; all circuits throughout the empire together were also no more than 100,000; later between Qingli and Zhiping it rose to more than a million.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Song the forbidden army was one hundred thousand; all circuits throughout the empire together were also no more than one hundred thousand; later between the Qingli and Zhiping reigns it rose to more than a million.

sentences.zh: 然其時財用不絀。

translations.literal: Yet at that time finances were not strained.
translations.idiomatic: Yet at that time state finances were not strained.

sentences.zh: 我朝邊兵四十萬。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's frontier troops are 400,000.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty's frontier troops number four hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 其後雖增兵益戍，而主兵多缺，不若宋人十倍其初也。

translations.literal: Later, though troops and garrisons were increased, regular troops are mostly short—not even a tenth of the Song at the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: Later, though troops and garrisons were increased, regular troops are mostly understrength—not even a tenth of what the Song had at the beginning.

sentences.zh: 然自嘉靖中即以絀乏告，何哉？

translations.literal: Yet from the Jiajing period strain has been reported—why?
translations.idiomatic: Yet from the Jiajing period strain has been reported—why?

sentences.zh: 宋雖增兵，而天下無養兵費。

translations.literal: Though Song increased troops, the empire had no cost of maintaining troops.
translations.idiomatic: Though Song increased troops, the empire had no cost of maintaining troops.

sentences.zh: 我朝以民養兵，而新軍又一切仰太倉。

translations.literal: Our dynasty uses the people to maintain troops, and the new army again relies entirely on Taicang.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty uses the people to maintain troops, and the new army again relies entirely on the Taicang treasury.

sentences.zh: 舊餉不減，新餉日增，費一也。

translations.literal: Old pay is not reduced while new pay increases daily—this is expense one.
translations.idiomatic: Old pay is not reduced while new pay increases daily—this is the first expense.

sentences.zh: 周豐鎬、漢四都，率有其名而無實。

translations.literal: Zhou's Feng and Hao, Han's four capitals—all had the name but not the reality.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou's Feng and Hao, Han's four capitals—all had the name but not the reality.

sentences.zh: 我朝留都之設，建官置衛，坐食公帑，費二也。

translations.literal: Our dynasty's establishment of a secondary capital creates offices and guards that eat from the public treasury without working—this is expense two.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty's establishment of a secondary capital creates offices and guards that eat from the public treasury without working—this is the second expense.

sentences.zh: 唐、宋宗親或通名仕版，或散處民間。

translations.literal: Tang and Song imperial clansmen either entered the registers of office or were scattered among the people.
translations.idiomatic: Tang and Song imperial clansmen either entered the registers of office or were scattered among the people.

sentences.zh: 我朝分封列爵，不農不仕，吸民膏髓，費三也。

translations.literal: Our dynasty enfeoffs and ranks them; they neither farm nor serve office, sucking the marrow of the people—this is expense three.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty enfeoffs and ranks them; they neither farm nor hold office, sucking the marrow of the people—this is the third expense.

sentences.zh: 有此三者，儲畜安得不匱。

translations.literal: With these three, how can stored wealth not be exhausted?
translations.idiomatic: With these three, how can stored wealth not be exhausted?

sentences.zh: 而其間尤耗天下之財者，兵而已。

translations.literal: Among them what most drains the empire's wealth is soldiers alone.
translations.idiomatic: Among them what most drains the empire's wealth is the army alone.

sentences.zh: 夫陷鋒摧堅，旗鼓相當，兵之實也。

translations.literal: To break the vanguard and crush the strong, banners and drums matched—this is the reality of soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: To break the vanguard and crush the strong, banners and drums matched—this is what soldiers are for.

sentences.zh: 今邊兵有戰時，若腹兵則終世不一當敵。

translations.literal: Today frontier troops have times of battle, but interior troops may go a lifetime without once facing the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Today frontier troops see battle, but interior troops may go a lifetime without once facing the enemy.

sentences.zh: 每盜賊竊發，非陰陽、醫藥、雜職，則丞貳判簿為之將；

translations.literal: Whenever bandits steal out, if not yin-yang masters, physicians, or miscellaneous officials, then assistant prefects and registrars serve as commanders;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever bandits steal out, if not yin-yang masters, physicians, or miscellaneous officials, then assistant prefects and registrars serve as commanders;

sentences.zh: 非鄉民裏保，則義勇快壯為之兵。

translations.literal: if not village people and neighborhood wardens, then volunteer militia and bold youths serve as troops.
translations.idiomatic: if not village people and neighborhood wardens, then volunteer militia and bold youths serve as troops.

sentences.zh: 在北則借鹽丁礦徒，在南則借狼土。

translations.literal: In the north they borrow salt laborers and mine workers; in the south they borrow Lang native troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the north they borrow salt laborers and mine workers; in the south they borrow Lang native troops.

sentences.zh: 此皆腹兵不足用之驗也。

translations.literal: These are all proofs that interior troops are insufficient for use.
translations.idiomatic: These are all proofs that interior troops are insufficient for use.

sentences.zh: 當限以輪番守戍之法。

translations.literal: They should be limited by the method of rotating turns for garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: They should be limited by the method of rotating turns for garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 或遠不可征，或弱不可任，則聽其耕商，而移其食以餉邊。

translations.literal: Those too distant to be levied or too weak to be entrusted should be allowed to farm and trade, and their rations shifted to feed the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Those too distant to be levied or too weak to be entrusted should be allowed to farm and trade, and their rations shifted to feed the frontier.

sentences.zh: 如免班軍而征償，省充發而輸贖，亦變通一策也。

translations.literal: Such as exempting rotating troops and collecting compensation, reducing banishment and accepting ransom—this too is one flexible measure.
translations.idiomatic: Such as exempting rotating troops and collecting compensation, reducing banishment and accepting ransom—this too is one flexible measure.

sentences.zh: 欲京兵強，亦宜責以輪番戍守。

translations.literal: To make capital troops strong, they too should be charged with rotating garrison duty.
translations.idiomatic: To make capital troops strong, they too should be charged with rotating garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 夫京師去宣府、薊鎮才數百里，京營九萬卒，歲以一萬戍二鎮，九年而一周，未為苦也，而怯者與邊兵同其勁矣。

translations.literal: The capital is only several hundred li from Xuanfu and Jizhen; the capital garrison has 90,000 soldiers—if 10,000 garrison the two circuits each year, the cycle completes in nine years, which is not hardship, and the timid would share the frontier troops' vigor.
translations.idiomatic: The capital is only several hundred li from Xuanfu and Jizhen; the capital garrison has ninety thousand soldiers—if ten thousand garrison the two circuits each year, the cycle completes in nine years, which is no great hardship, and the timid would share the frontier troops' vigor.

sentences.zh: 又以畿輔之卒填京戍之闕，其部伍、號令、月糧、犒賞亦與京卒同，而畿輔之卒皆親兵矣。

translations.literal: Use metropolitan-region troops to fill gaps in capital garrison duty; their units, orders, monthly grain, and rewards would be the same as capital troops, and metropolitan-region troops would all become personal troops.
translations.idiomatic: Use metropolitan-region troops to fill gaps in capital garrison duty; their units, orders, monthly grain, and rewards would be the same as capital troops, and metropolitan-region troops would all become personal troops.

sentences.zh: 夫京卒戍薊鎮，則延、固之費可省。

translations.literal: If capital troops garrison Jizhen, the cost of Yan and Gu can be saved.
translations.idiomatic: If capital troops garrison Jizhen, the cost of Yan and Gu can be saved.

sentences.zh: 戍宣府，則宣府、大同之氣自張。

translations.literal: If they garrison Xuanfu, the spirit of Xuanfu and Datong would naturally rise.
translations.idiomatic: If they garrison Xuanfu, the spirit of Xuanfu and Datong would naturally rise.

sentences.zh: 寇畏宣、大之力制其後，京卒之勁當其前，則仰攻深入之事鮮矣。

translations.literal: Raiders would fear the power of Xuan and Da holding their rear and the vigor of capital troops blocking their front—then uphill attacks and deep penetration would be rare.
translations.idiomatic: Raiders would fear the power of Xuanfu and Datong holding their rear and the vigor of capital troops blocking their front—then uphill attacks and deep penetration would be rare.

sentences.zh: 臣又睹天下之民皇皇以匱乏為慮者，非布帛五谷不足也，銀不足耳。

translations.literal: I also see the people of the empire anxiously worried about shortage—not that cloth, silk, and the five grains are insufficient, but silver alone.
translations.idiomatic: I also see the people of the empire anxiously worried about shortage—not that cloth, silk, and the five grains are insufficient, but silver alone.

sentences.zh: 夫銀，寒不可衣，饑不可食，不過貿遷以通衣食之用，獨奈何用銀而廢錢？

translations.literal: Silver cannot be worn against cold or eaten against hunger; it is only for exchange to circulate the use of clothing and food—why use silver alone and abandon coin?
translations.idiomatic: Silver cannot be worn against cold or eaten against hunger; it is only for exchange to circulate the use of clothing and food—why use silver alone and abandon coin?

sentences.zh: 錢益廢，銀益獨行。

translations.literal: As coin is further abandoned, silver further circulates alone.
translations.idiomatic: As coin is further abandoned, silver circulates alone all the more.

sentences.zh: 獨行則藏益深，而銀益貴，貨益賤，而折色之辦益難。

translations.literal: Alone in circulation, hoarding grows deeper, silver grows dearer, goods grow cheaper, and conversion payments grow harder.
translations.idiomatic: Alone in circulation, hoarding grows deeper, silver grows dearer, goods grow cheaper, and conversion payments grow harder.

sentences.zh: 豪右乘其賤收之，時其貴出之。

translations.literal: Powerful families buy when goods are cheap and sell when silver is dear.
translations.idiomatic: Powerful families buy when goods are cheap and sell when silver is dear.

sentences.zh: 銀積於豪右者愈厚，行於天下者愈少。

translations.literal: Silver accumulated by the powerful grows thicker; that circulating in the empire grows less.
translations.idiomatic: Silver accumulated by the powerful grows thicker; that circulating in the empire grows less.

sentences.zh: 更逾數十年，臣不知所底止矣。

translations.literal: After several more decades, I do not know where it will end.
translations.idiomatic: After several more decades, I do not know where it will end.

sentences.zh: 錢者，泉也，不可一日無。

translations.literal: Coin is a spring; it cannot be absent for a day.
translations.idiomatic: Coin is a spring; it cannot be absent for a day.

sentences.zh: 計者謂錢法之難有二：利不鸑本，民不願行。

translations.literal: Planners say the difficulties of coinage are two: profit does not cover capital, and the people are unwilling to circulate it.
translations.idiomatic: Planners say the difficulties of coinage are two: profit does not cover capital, and the people are unwilling to circulate it.

sentences.zh: 此皆非也。

translations.literal: Neither is so.
translations.idiomatic: Neither is so.

sentences.zh: 夫朝廷以山海之產為材，以億兆之力為工，以賢士大夫為役，何本之費？

translations.literal: The court uses products of mountains and seas as material, the strength of hundreds of millions as labor, and worthy scholar-officials as overseers—what cost of capital?
translations.idiomatic: The court uses products of mountains and seas as material, the strength of hundreds of millions as labor, and worthy scholar-officials as overseers—what cost of capital?

sentences.zh: 誠令民以銅炭贖罪，而匠役則取之營軍，一指麾間，錢遍天下矣。

translations.literal: Truly order the people to redeem crimes with copper and charcoal, and take artisans from the military camps—with one command coin would spread throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Truly order the people to redeem crimes with copper and charcoal, and take artisans from the military camps—with one command coin would spread throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 至不顧行錢者，獨奸豪爾。

translations.literal: As for those who disregard circulating coin, it is only the powerful schemers.
translations.idiomatic: As for those who disregard circulating coin, it is only the powerful schemers.

sentences.zh: 請自今事例、罰贖、征稅、賜賚、宗祿、官俸、軍餉之屬，悉銀錢兼支。

translations.literal: I ask that from now on precedent purchases, fines and ransoms, taxation, gifts and rewards, clan stipends, official salaries, army pay, and the like all pay in both silver and coin.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that from now on precedent purchases, fines and ransoms, taxation, gifts and rewards, clan stipends, official salaries, army pay, and the like all pay in both silver and coin.

sentences.zh: 上以是征，下以是輸，何患其不行哉。

translations.literal: Above levies thus, below pays thus—why worry that it will not circulate?
translations.idiomatic: Above levies thus, below pays thus—why worry that it will not circulate?

sentences.zh: 臣又聞中原者，邊鄙之根本也。

translations.literal: I also hear that the Central Plain is the root of the frontier marches.
translations.idiomatic: I also hear that the Central Plain is the root of the frontier marches.

sentences.zh: 百姓者，中原之根本也，民有終身無銀，而不能終歲無衣，終日無食。

translations.literal: The common people are the root of the Central Plain; a man may go a lifetime without silver but cannot go a year without clothing or a day without food.
translations.idiomatic: The common people are the root of the Central Plain; a man may go a lifetime without silver but cannot go a year without clothing or a day without food.

sentences.zh: 今有司夙夜不遑者，乃在銀而不在谷，臣竊慮之。

translations.literal: Today what keeps officials busy day and night is silver, not grain—I privately worry.
translations.idiomatic: Today what keeps officials busy day and night is silver, not grain—I worry about this privately.

sentences.zh: 國家建都幽燕，北無郡國之衛，所恃為腹心股肱者，河南、山東、江北及畿內八府之人心耳。

translations.literal: The state established its capital in Youyan; northward there is no protection of commanderies and states; what it relies on as heart and limbs is the hearts of the people in Henan, Shandong, Jiangbei, and the eight metropolitan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The state established its capital in Youyan; northward there is no protection of commanderies and states; what it relies on as heart and limbs is the loyalty of the people in Henan, Shandong, Jiangbei, and the eight metropolitan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 其人率鷙悍而輕生，易動而難戢，遊食而寡積者也。

translations.literal: Those people are generally fierce and bold, lightly esteem life, easily stirred and hard to restrain, wandering for food and little storing.
translations.idiomatic: Those people are generally fierce and bold, lightly esteem life, easily stirred and hard to restrain, wandering for food and storing little.

sentences.zh: 一不如意，則輕去其鄉；

translations.literal: At one disappointment they lightly leave their native place;
translations.idiomatic: At one disappointment they lightly leave their native place;

sentences.zh: 往往一夫作難，千人響應，前事已屢驗矣。

translations.literal: often one man raises trouble and a thousand respond—past affairs have repeatedly proved this.
translations.idiomatic: often one man raises trouble and a thousand respond—past affairs have repeatedly proved this.

sentences.zh: 弭之之計，不過曰恤農以系其家，足食以系其身，聚骨肉以系其心。

translations.literal: The plan to calm them is nothing more than to comfort farming to bind their families, provide sufficient food to bind their persons, and gather kin to bind their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: The plan to calm them is nothing more than to comfort farming to bind their families, provide sufficient food to bind their persons, and gather kin to bind their hearts.

sentences.zh: 今試核官廩之所藏，每府得數十萬，則司計者安枕可矣。

translations.literal: Now try auditing what official granaries store: if each prefecture has several hundred thousand, the finance officers may rest easy.
translations.idiomatic: Now try auditing what official granaries store: if each prefecture has several hundred thousand, the finance officers may rest easy.

sentences.zh: 得三萬焉，猶足塞轉徙者之望。

translations.literal: With thirty thousand it is still enough to satisfy those who would migrate.
translations.idiomatic: With thirty thousand it is still enough to satisfy those who would migrate.

sentences.zh: 設不滿萬，豈得無寒心？

translations.literal: If it does not reach ten thousand, how can they not lose heart?
translations.idiomatic: If it does not reach ten thousand, how can they not lose heart?

sentences.zh: 臣竊意不滿萬者多也。

translations.literal: I privately suspect that those not reaching ten thousand are many.
translations.idiomatic: I privately suspect that those not reaching ten thousand are many.

sentences.zh: 臣近者疏請積谷，業蒙允行。

translations.literal: I recently memorialized asking to store grain and have already received approval.
translations.idiomatic: I recently memorialized asking to store grain and have already received approval.

sentences.zh: 第恐有司從事不力，無以塞明詔。

translations.literal: I only fear officials will not exert themselves fully and cannot fulfill the clear edict.
translations.idiomatic: I only fear officials will not exert themselves fully and cannot fulfill the clear edict.

sentences.zh: 敢即臣說申言之：

translations.literal: I venture to elaborate on my proposal:
translations.idiomatic: I venture to elaborate on my proposal:

sentences.zh: 其一曰官倉，發官銀以糴也。

translations.literal: The first is official granaries, purchasing grain with official silver.
translations.idiomatic: The first is official granaries, purchasing grain with official silver.

sentences.zh: 一曰社倉，收民谷以充也。

translations.literal: The second is community granaries, collecting people's grain to fill them.
translations.idiomatic: The second is community granaries, collecting people's grain to fill them.

sentences.zh: 官倉非甚豐歲不能舉，社倉雖中歲皆可行。

translations.literal: Official granaries cannot be undertaken except in very abundant years; community granaries can be undertaken even in average years.
translations.idiomatic: Official granaries cannot be undertaken except in very abundant years; community granaries can be undertaken even in average years.

sentences.zh: 唐義倉之開，每歲自王公以下皆有入。

translations.literal: When Tang opened charity granaries, each year from princes and dukes downward all contributed.
translations.idiomatic: When Tang opened charity granaries, each year from princes and dukes downward all contributed.

sentences.zh: 宋則準民間正稅之數，取二十分之一以為社。

translations.literal: Song took one-twentieth of the regular tax levied on the people as community stock.
translations.idiomatic: Song took one-twentieth of the regular tax levied on the people as community stock.

sentences.zh: 誠仿而推之，就土俗，合人情，占歲候以通其變，計每歲二倉之入以驗其功，著為令，而歲歲修之，時其豐歉而斂散之。

translations.literal: Truly imitate and extend this, suit local custom, accord with human feeling, read the seasons to adapt changes, calculate each year's intake of the two granaries to verify achievement, set it as statute, repair yearly, and gather or release according to abundance or shortage.
translations.idiomatic: Truly imitate and extend this, suit local custom, accord with human feeling, read the seasons to adapt changes, calculate each year's intake of the two granaries to verify achievement, set it as statute, repair yearly, and gather or release according to abundance or shortage.

sentences.zh: 在官倉者，民有大饑則以振。

translations.literal: What is in official granaries is used to relieve when the people suffer great famine.
translations.idiomatic: What is in official granaries is used to relieve when the people suffer great famine.

sentences.zh: 在民倉者，雖官有大役亦不聽貸。

translations.literal: What is in people's granaries is not lent even when the state has great corvée.
translations.idiomatic: What is in people's granaries is not lent even when the state has great corvée.

sentences.zh: 借此藏富於民，即藏富於國也。

translations.literal: By this store wealth among the people—that is to store wealth in the state.
translations.idiomatic: By this store wealth among the people—that is to store wealth in the state.

sentences.zh: 今言財用者，不憂谷之不足，而憂銀之不足。

translations.literal: Today those who speak of finances do not worry that grain is insufficient but worry that silver is insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Today those who speak of finances do not worry that grain is insufficient but worry that silver is insufficient.

sentences.zh: 夫銀實生亂，谷實弭亂。

translations.literal: Silver truly breeds disorder; grain truly calms disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Silver truly breeds disorder; grain truly calms disorder.

sentences.zh: 銀之不足，而泉貨代之；

translations.literal: If silver is insufficient, currency can replace it;
translations.idiomatic: If silver is insufficient, currency can replace it;

sentences.zh: 五谷不足，則孰可以代者哉？

translations.literal: if the five grains are insufficient, what can replace them?
translations.idiomatic: if the five grains are insufficient, what can replace them?

sentences.zh: 故曰明君不寶金玉，而寶五谷，伏惟聖明垂意。

translations.literal: Therefore it is said that an enlightened ruler does not treasure gold and jade but treasures the five grains—I humbly hope the sage will give heed.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore it is said that an enlightened ruler does not treasure gold and jade but treasures the five grains—I humbly hope Your Majesty will give heed.

sentences.zh: 疏入，下所司議，卒不能盡行也。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, it was sent down to responsible offices for deliberation; in the end it could not all be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial entered, it was sent down to responsible offices for deliberation; in the end it could not all be implemented.

sentences.zh: 尋召為工部右侍郎，改吏部，進左侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned as Right Vice Minister of Works, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, and advanced to Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was summoned as Right Vice Minister of Works, transferred to the Ministry of Personnel, and promoted to Left Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 學顏內行修潔，見高拱以首輔掌銓，專恣甚，遂謝病歸，卒。

translations.literal: Xueyan's inner conduct was cultivated and pure; seeing Gao Gong as chief minister control appointments and act with great arbitrariness, he resigned on grounds of illness and died.
translations.idiomatic: Xueyan's inner conduct was cultivated and pure; seeing Gao Gong as chief minister control appointments and act with great arbitrariness, he resigned on grounds of illness and died.

sentences.zh: 弟學曾，山西副使。

translations.literal: His younger brother Xuezeng was Vice Commissioner of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Xuezeng served as Vice Commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 治績亦有聞。

translations.literal: His governance also had reputation.
translations.idiomatic: His governance was also well regarded.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：明之中葉，邊防墮，經費乏。

translations.literal: The appraiser says: In the mid-Ming, frontier defense declined and funds were scarce.
translations.idiomatic: The appraiser says: In the mid-Ming, frontier defense declined and funds were scarce.

sentences.zh: 當時任事之臣，能留意於此者鮮矣。

translations.literal: Among ministers then in charge of affairs, few paid heed to this.
translations.idiomatic: Among ministers then in charge of affairs, few paid heed to this.

sentences.zh: 若楊博、馬森、劉體乾、葛守禮、靳學顏之屬，庶幾負經濟之略者。

translations.literal: Men such as Yang Bo, Ma Sen, Liu Tigan, Ge Shouli, and Jin Xueyan were perhaps those who bore strategies of state economy.
translations.idiomatic: Men such as Yang Bo, Ma Sen, Liu Tigan, Ge Shouli, and Jin Xueyan were perhaps those who bore strategies of state economy.

sentences.zh: 就其設施與其所建白，究而行之，亦補苴一時而已，況言之不盡行，行之不能久乎！

translations.literal: As for their measures and what they proposed, even if fully carried out they would only patch the moment; moreover, what was said was not fully done, and what was done could not long endure!
translations.idiomatic: As for their measures and what they proposed, even if fully carried out they would only patch the moment; moreover, what was said was not fully done, and what was done could not long endure!

sentences.zh: 自時厥後，張居正始一整飭。

translations.literal: From that time onward, Zhang Juzheng first brought a general rectification.
translations.idiomatic: From that time onward, Zhang Juzheng first brought a general rectification.

sentences.zh: 居正歿，一切以空言從事，以迄於亡。

translations.literal: When Juzheng died, everything was pursued in empty words until extinction.
translations.idiomatic: When Juzheng died, everything was pursued in empty words until the dynasty fell.

sentences.zh: 蓋其壞非朝夕之積矣。

translations.literal: Its ruin was not the accumulation of a morning or an evening.
translations.idiomatic: Its ruin was not the work of a morning or an evening.
